_comment: CANONICAL AUTH-NAV CONTRACT — the single definition of the session's storage keys, the account routes, and the four nav labels. Consumed directly by lib/auth-session.ts, lib/auth-i18n.ts (AUTH_LABELS.nav) and components/seo/NavAuth.tsx; mirrored into public/assets/starta-auth-nav.js for the static HTML pages, which cannot import JSON.
